newsitem.title: CHINA: Tung scores high on HK welfare, lower on freedom.
newsitem.headline: Tung scores high on HK welfare, lower on freedom.

text.p: Hong Kong people are confident their new leader Tung Chee-hwa will take care of the crucial issues concerning their livelihood but are less sure that he will promote democracy and freedom, a survey showed on Thursday.
In the poll conducted by the Chinese University of Hong Kong and published by the Apple Daily newspaper, Tung scored 65 out of 100 for his emphasis on social welfare issues,
The former shipping tycoon scored 55.6 on whether he would allow the advance of the democracy movement, and 56.9 on whether he would protect existing rights.
The poll was conducted on July 22 and covered 585 people.
The former British colony returned to Chinese rule on July 1. It has been promised a high degree of autonomy for the next 50 years under Sino-British handover treaties.
